mcat_description.short: PVC Guard Huts are prefabricated, portable security cabins constructed from PVC foam profile panels, sold as complete assembled or knock-down units per piece for deployment at gated entry points.
mcat_description.long: PVC Guard Huts are lightweight, prefabricated security shelters built using solid PVC foam profile panels with tongue-and-groove interlocking walls, PVC or UPVC flooring, and a PVC roof, supported by an MS box-section structural frame. They are manufactured in standard sizes (3×3, 4×4, 6×4, 6×6 ft) with customisation available, and are designed for tool-free or minimal-tool assembly and easy relocation without a permanent foundation. Key material properties include flame retardancy, corrosion resistance, thermal and sound insulation, and all-weather durability rated for wind speeds up to 120 km/h. In the Indian B2B market, these units are sold per piece to residential societies, industrial facilities, construction sites, and government/institutional buyers as a cost-effective alternative to brick-and-mortar guard rooms.

market_context: PVC Guard Huts occupy a distinct sub-segment within the broader prefabricated security cabin market in India, differentiated from steel, FRP, and PUF-panel variants by their all-PVC construction (walls, roof, doors, and windows made from solid PVC foam profiles with tongue-and-groove interlocking). The Indian market offers standard sizes of 3×3, 4×4, 6×4, and 6×6 ft, with customisation widely available; units are typically delivered fully assembled or as semi-knocked-down (SKD) kits for on-site assembly without a permanent foundation. Key buyer-facing differentiators are corrosion resistance, low maintenance, lightweight portability, and all-weather performance — with some manufacturers citing wind resistance up to 120 km/h and seismic Zone III–IV compliance. The category sits within a competitive landscape that includes steel guard cabins, FRP security cabins, and PUF-insulated cabins; PVC variants are positioned as the most economical and lowest-maintenance option, particularly favoured by residential societies, SME industrial buyers, and construction contractors. Manufacturers are concentrated in Delhi-NCR, Chennai, Mumbai/Thane, and Faridabad; the market is largely unorganised with a mix of small fabricators and mid-size prefab companies (EPACK, Pressmach, GGR, Tinnycraft). No BIS or IS standard specifically governs PVC guard huts as a product category — quality is manufacturer-defined.
